source_text: Spiritus Dei factus est super Balaam. Vidit Israel habitantem per tribus; assumentes parabolam dixit.
pass_a_gloss: Spirit of-God made is upon Balaam. He-saw Israel dwelling by tribes; taking up parable he-said.
pass_b_english: [[The Spirit of God came upon Balaam >> Bible:Numbers 24:2]]. He saw Israel camped by tribes and took up his parable.
